features.label: Liveiness
features.description: Versioned per-mode adapter modulating effective appearance from immutable bases. Neutral 0.5 is identity. State bytes are declared per admitted adapter by MOD.

features.label: Persistence
features.description: History retention with a half-life semantic. Bypass passes the current frame; re-enable starts from an empty history. State bytes declared by VP.

features.label: Palette travel
features.description: Bounded automatic excursion around the palette position. Bypass holds the base position.

features.label: Base coat
features.description: Bounded foundation beneath active material. Bypass adds nothing.

features.label: Colour treatment
features.description: Common colour treatment in a declared working domain (saturation, warmth, contrast). Bypass is identity.

features.label: Rhythm layer
features.description: Balance of eligible rhythmic layers. Bypass renders the mode's incumbent rhythm treatment.

features.label: Audio focus
features.description: Mode-adapted body/transient evidence balance. Bypass uses the mode's incumbent evidence weighting.

contexts.label: Palette path
contexts.description: Full palette path, selected window, current sample and excursion; only part of a palette may be reachable.

contexts.label: Colour change
contexts.description: Before and after swatches in a named illustrative colour model; not calibrated LED output.

contexts.label: Transfer curve
contexts.description: Transfer curve and affected tonal region; master and current limits may mask a requested gain.

contexts.label: Trajectory
contexts.description: Centre-origin trajectory with speed arrow and occupied-width envelope.

contexts.label: Decay envelope
contexts.description: Impulse and decay envelope with highlighted half-life.

contexts.label: Rhythm evidence
contexts.description: Primary pulse and weaker secondary evidence with age and validity; authored mix is not detector confidence.

contexts.label: Liveiness modulation
contexts.description: Base versus effective values under the admitted adapter; unsupported modes say so.

contexts.label: Output power
contexts.description: Master, blackout and current-limit authority; distinct from channel intensity and legacy Photons.

liveiness_adapters.unadmitted_reason: No per-mode adapter admitted; MOD registers adapters with version, neutral identity, bounds and fixtures.

notes: v1 remains interpretable and byte-identical: 71 controls, Photons floor 0.05 = Q0.16 3277, Mood IDs 5/25 and Chroma IDs 4/24 keep their compatibility decoding.
v2 semantic identifiers are 16-bit in [0x0100, 0x0FFF]; v1 identifiers are 8-bit 0..70, so no v2 identifier can alias a v1 identifier. Exact v1 meanings carry an explicit v1_alias.
Channel intensity, legacy Photons, artistic density, the global master and the electrical current limit are distinct semantics.
Every artistic feature has an enable parameter separate from its amounts; new feature enables default off so incumbent output is unchanged until admission.
Support states come from source evidence: implemented means a consumer exists on that platform; the v2 routing of an implemented legacy semantic is INT's integration step.
